effects.notes: Each time you use one of the food-providing action spaces Day Laborer, Fishing, Traveling Players, or Resource Market, gain 1 additional wood. The BGA wiki commentary also lists Archway and Forest Inn as triggering spaces; both are outside the 2016 base board and are not enumerated in the condition.

review.notes: Each time you get food from an action space, gain 1 additional wood. The trigger spaces are enumerated as Day Laborer, Fishing, Traveling Players, and Resource Market — the same four spaces as the engine implementation (src/cards.rs verified_band_e_cards) and the base ledger role column (日雇い/漁/小劇場/資材市場). The BGA wiki commentary additionally lists Archway and Forest Inn as triggering spaces; both are outside the 2016 base board and are not enumerated in the condition.
